messages:
Maya Patel: follow-ups on compose() after the merge + staging canary. a couple tweaks landed on top of PR-81234.

Liam O'Connor: anything materially different from docs/compose.md? esp injection defaults + compat.

Maya Patel: yeah 2 changes:
1) injection default is now conditional: default stays `separate` for native runtime calls, but OpenAI-compat endpoint defaults to `inline` *only when* `compat.mode=openai` is set. too many customers expected tool output in the stream.
2) renamed compat toggle: `config.auto_function_to_tool` -> `compat.auto_tool_from_function_call` (old name still accepted, logs deprecation warning).

Renee Zhao: what about the worker pool change? last review we were worried about thread-per-tool.

Maya Patel: runner uses bounded async pool now + hard cap. also added `composition.max_parallel_tools` (default 16) and a per-host semaphore to avoid tiny nodes getting swamped.

Diego Martinez: are retries/attempts still visible per tool in console traces?

Maya Patel: yep. we added `attempts`, `last_error`, and `retry_delay_ms` tags per step span. dashboards updated (compose_latency_breakdown + compose_retries).

Liam O'Connor: rollout status?

Deploy Bot: staging: composition.v1 enabled 100% (no regressions). prod: composition.v1 enabled 25% (canary group: us-east-1a).

Maya Patel: plan is hold 25% for 48h, then 50% if p95 model latency + error rate stay flat. also we’re tracking new metric `runtime.compose.injection_mode` broken out by compat/native.

Renee Zhao: do we need to update any migration notes? the conditional default seems important.

Maya Patel: yep, i patched docs + added a note in release notes draft: "OpenAI-compat defaults to inline injection; native remains separate". also added example config snippet.

Diego Martinez: any breaking behavior for existing users?

Maya Patel: no API removals. only behavior change is for callers going through compat with no explicit injection setting; they’ll now see inline outputs like they expected. native callers unchanged.

Liam O'Connor: cool. pls link the follow-up commit in #sdk too.

Maya Patel: will do.
